hints.tr: `x, y = fraction.split("/")`; iki parça çıkmazsa (`1/2/3`, `cat`) bu satır da `ValueError` verir.
hints.en: `x, y = fraction.split("/")`; if it does not split in two (`1/2/3`, `cat`), this line raises a `ValueError` too.

hints.tr: Negatif `X` ve `X > Y` hata vermez; onları `if 0 <= x <= y:` ile ayır.
hints.en: A negative `X` and `X > Y` raise no error; sort them out with `if 0 <= x <= y:`.
